canvas.$description: Canvas — Page background, muted surface fills, secondary buttons

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, popover backgrounds, primary button fills

surface-alt.$description: Surface Alt — Sidebar background, subtle card variant, input resting state

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, headings, button labels, icon strokes

ink-soft.$description: Ink Soft — Filled button backgrounds, secondary text on light surfaces

mid-gray.$description: Mid Gray — Muted body text, placeholder text, helper labels, icon fills at rest

hairline.$description: Hairline — Borders, input outlines, card edges, badge outlines

ember.$description: Ember — Red decorative accent for icons, marks, and small graphic details. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

geist.$description: All interface text — body at 14px/400, headings ranging 24–48px/600, buttons at 13–14px/500. Geist's geometric letterforms and uniform stroke width create a developer-tool neutrality; weight 600 at 48px with -0.05em tracking produces tight, confident display headlines that feel engineered rather than editorial.
